items.source: Starts building a custom EntityLookup for the given repository type and registers the domain type of the given repository as lookup type.
items.translation: 开始为给定的仓库类型构建自定义的 EntityLookup，并将给定仓库的域类型注册为查找类型。

items.source: Starts building a custom EntityLookup for the given repository type.
items.translation: 开始为给定的仓库类型构建自定义的EntityLookup。

items.source: Registers an EntityLookup for the given repository type, identifier mapping and lookup operation.
items.translation: 为给定的仓库类型、标识符映射和查找操作注册一个 EntityLookup。

items.source: Registers an EntityLookup for the given repository type, identifier mapping and lookup operation and registers the domain type managed by the given repository as lookup type.
items.translation: 为给定的仓库类型、标识符映射和查找操作注册一个 EntityLookup，并将由给定仓库管理的域类型注册为查找类型。
